newsitem.title: USA: US Senate ag leaders seen set, House unclear - Aides.
newsitem.headline: US Senate ag leaders seen set, House unclear - Aides.

text.p: The same four senators are likely to be Senate Agriculture subcommittee chairmen next year but it is impossible to say who will hold subcommittee chairs on the House panel, aides said Thursday.

"It's insane" to try to predict who will hold the House posts, said one staff worker, because of the huge turnover on the Agriculture Committee. Three senior members were elected to the Senate and one retired.
Indiana Republican Richard Lugar was expected to return as Senate Agrculture chairman. Bob Smith, Oregon Republican, held seniority to take the House panel's chairmanship.
